description: Shorti(쇼티) for a TikTok, Reels or Shorts link with «how was this shot?», «이 영상 어떻게 찍었어?» or «분석해줘». One video: what happens in it, its beats, its numbers and its formats. By post `url` or `video_id`: its hook, turn and beats; the moments worth copying and how; what it takes to shoot it again; views and length; its formats. not_in_corpus when Shorti has not read it. detail='full' adds every field.
